intro.zh: 先分清发生在哪一层，再决定改什么。所有例子均为假设，不是本站成绩。
intro.en: Identify the layer before deciding what to change. All examples are hypothetical, not this site’s results.

disclaimer.zh: SEO 不能保证收录或排名。这里的技术规则以 Google 官方说明为准；其他引擎需另行核对。
disclaimer.en: SEO guarantees neither indexing nor rankings. Technical rules here refer to Google documentation; verify other engines separately.

meaning.en: The engine knows the URL exists.

notEquivalentToNext.zh: 不代表已正确渲染或收录。
notEquivalentToNext.en: Does not prove correct rendering or indexing.

meaning.en: The page entered the search index.

meaning.zh: 来自结果的点击被记录。
目标动作发生并被可靠验证。
meaning.en: A target action occurred and was reliably verified.

notEquivalentToNext.zh: 不是所有使用行为都等于收入。

funnelNote.zh: 这是概念顺序，不是一张能直接相除的统计报表：URL 数、曝光次数、点击次数和转化事件不是同一单位。没有填入虚构流量或转化率。
funnelNote.en: This is a conceptual sequence, not a directly divisible analytics report: URLs, impressions, clicks, and conversion events use different units. No traffic or conversion data is invented.

plain.zh: 一个人搜索这句话时，真正想完成的事。
plain.en: The task someone wants to complete with a search.

example.zh: 假设搜索“压缩图片不损画质”，可能想马上用工具，而非读格式历史。
example.en: Suppose someone searches “compress images without losing quality”: they may want a tool now.

dontConfuse.zh: 你希望卖什么，不一定是对方想找什么；意图是待验证判断。
dontConfuse.en: Your sales goal is not necessarily their goal; intent is a hypothesis.

evidence.zh: 实际结果页的页面类型、用户原话、试用反馈。
evidence.en: Result-page formats, users’ own words, and usability feedback.

plain.zh: 查询是用户实际输入的话；关键词是你研究和组织主题时用的词。
plain.en: A query is what someone searches; a keyword is a term you use to plan content.

example.zh: 假设用户输入“png 怎么变小”，你把它归到“PNG 压缩”主题。
example.en: Suppose the query is “make png smaller”; you group it under PNG compression.

dontConfuse.zh: 不必给每个近义词各做一页，也不是重复越多越好。
dontConfuse.en: Synonyms need not each get a page; repetition is not the goal.

evidence.zh: GSC 查询、访谈用词、同主题结果页。
evidence.en: Search Console queries, interview language, and related search results.

plain.zh: 需求分布里较少被单独搜索、通常更具体的一类查询。
plain.en: A less frequently searched query, often expressing a more specific need.

example.zh: 假设“批量压缩透明 PNG”比“图片”需求更具体；真实搜索量仍要查。
example.en: “Batch compress transparent PNGs” is more specific than “images”; volume still needs evidence.

dontConfuse.zh: 长尾不是单纯字数多，也不保证低竞争或高转化。
dontConfuse.en: Long-tail does not just mean more words, or guarantee easy rankings or conversions.

evidence.zh: 查询细节与需求证据；工具搜索量只作估计。
evidence.en: Query detail and demand evidence; tool volumes are estimates.

plain.zh: 搜索后出现的整页结果，可能包含自然结果、广告与其他模块。
plain.en: The full results page, which can include organic results, ads, and other features.

example.zh: 假设搜“图片压缩”，记录前排是工具、教程还是产品对比。
example.en: For “image compression”, note whether leading results are tools, guides, or comparisons.

dontConfuse.zh: 广告位不等于自然排名；一次截图不是所有人的结果。
dontConfuse.en: An ad is not an organic ranking; one screenshot is not everyone’s result.

evidence.zh: 记录查询、时间、地区、设备、结果类型。
evidence.en: Record query, time, region, device, and result formats.

plain.zh: 搜索引擎知道这个网址存在。
plain.en: The search engine learns that a URL exists.

example.zh: 假设旧教程链接到新工具页，爬虫可从链接发现新网址。
example.en: An existing guide links to a new tool, providing a discovery path.

dontConfuse.zh: 被发现不等于已经访问或收录。
dontConfuse.en: Discovery does not mean the URL was crawled or indexed.

evidence.zh: URL 检查中的已知状态、引用页或站点地图信息。
evidence.en: URL Inspection status and available referring-page or sitemap information.

plain.zh: 爬虫向服务器请求页面和资源。
plain.en: A crawler requests a page and its resources from the server.

example.zh: 假设 Googlebot 请求 /compress，服务器返回网页。
example.en: Suppose Googlebot requests /compress and the server returns a page.

dontConfuse.zh: 返回成功不等于内容已被索引。
dontConfuse.en: A successful response does not prove indexing.

evidence.zh: URL 检查的上次抓取与获取状态；必要时核验服务器日志。
evidence.en: Last crawl and fetch status in URL Inspection; verified server logs when needed.

plain.zh: 运行页面代码，把页面组装成可读取的内容。
plain.en: Running page code to assemble the readable page.

example.zh: 假设说明文字由 JavaScript 加载，检查渲染后是否真的出现。
example.en: If JavaScript loads instructions, check that rendered content contains them.

dontConfuse.zh: 自己浏览器看得见，不证明爬虫也能得到相同内容。
dontConfuse.en: Working in your browser does not prove equivalent crawler access.

evidence.zh: URL 检查的渲染 HTML、截图与资源加载结果。
evidence.en: Rendered HTML, screenshots, and resource-loading results in URL Inspection.

plain.zh: 搜索引擎处理页面，并将相关信息存入搜索索引。
plain.en: The engine processes a page and stores information in its search index.

example.zh: 假设 URL 检查报告该页面已编入索引，它才具备被检索的基础。
example.en: Suppose URL Inspection reports the page indexed: it has entered the searchable index.

dontConfuse.zh: 已收录不保证会在某个查询下展示。
dontConfuse.en: Being indexed does not guarantee appearance for a particular query.

evidence.zh: URL 检查与网页索引报告；不要只依赖 site: 搜索计数。
evidence.en: URL Inspection and Page indexing reports, not just site: result counts.

plain.zh: 搜索引擎针对一次查询选择和排列结果。
plain.en: How the engine selects and orders results for a query.

example.zh: 假设同一工具在“PNG 压缩”和“缩小 JPG”中位置不同。
example.en: A tool may rank differently for “PNG compression” and “shrink JPG”.

dontConfuse.zh: 没有一个永久、适用于所有查询和地区的站点排名。
dontConfuse.en: There is no permanent site-wide rank across all queries and regions.

evidence.zh: 按查询、页面、国家、设备拆分观察 GSC。
evidence.en: Inspect Search Console by query, page, country, and device.

plain.zh: 搜索结果按相应统计规则记录了你的链接展示。
plain.en: Your link received a recorded search-result impression under that result type’s rules.

example.zh: 假设报告显示 100 次曝光，只说明被记录了 100 次展示。
example.en: Suppose the report shows 100 impressions: it records 100 qualifying appearances.

dontConfuse.zh: 曝光不是 100 个独立访客，也不是 100 次点击。
dontConfuse.en: Impressions are neither unique people nor clicks.

evidence.zh: GSC 曝光；保持搜索类型、日期和筛选条件一致。
evidence.en: Search Console impressions with consistent search type, dates, and filters.

plain.zh: 搜索结果中通往你站点的点击，按报告规则统计。
plain.en: Recorded clicks from search results to your site.

example.zh: 假设 GSC 有 10 次点击，继续查看这些访问是否完成任务。
example.en: Suppose Search Console records 10 clicks; next check whether visitors completed their task.

dontConfuse.zh: 点击不等于会话数、独立人数或购买。
dontConfuse.en: Clicks are not sessions, unique people, or purchases.

evidence.zh: GSC 点击与站内分析分开看，口径不必完全一致。
evidence.en: Read Search Console clicks and site analytics separately; their definitions differ.

plain.zh: 同一统计范围内，点击次数除以曝光次数。
plain.en: Clicks divided by impressions within the same reporting scope.

example.zh: 假设 100 次曝光、5 次点击，CTR 是 5%；这是算例。
example.en: Hypothetical: 5 clicks / 100 impressions = 5% CTR.

dontConfuse.zh: 没有适用于所有位置、查询和结果样式的好 CTR。
dontConfuse.en: No single good CTR applies to all positions, queries, and result formats.

evidence.zh: 同类查询与设备下比较；零曝光时不能计算有意义的 CTR。
evidence.en: Compare like queries and devices; zero impressions give no meaningful CTR.

plain.zh: GSC 对曝光时所记录位置的平均值；站点聚合通常取最靠前的结果。
plain.en: GSC’s mean recorded position across impressions; property aggregation uses the topmost result.

example.zh: 假设两次曝光位置为 2 和 8，简化算例的平均值为 5。
example.en: Simplified example: positions 2 and 8 across two impressions average to 5.

dontConfuse.zh: 平均位置 5 不代表每个人都看到你排第五。
dontConfuse.en: An average of 5 does not mean everyone saw you fifth.

evidence.zh: 先固定查询、页面、国家和设备，再结合曝光与点击看。
evidence.en: Hold query, page, country, and device steady; read alongside impressions and clicks.

plain.zh: 访问者完成你事先定义的有价值动作。
plain.en: A visitor completes a valuable action you defined in advance.

example.zh: 假设工具页的目标是成功导出压缩图片，记录导出成功事件。
example.en: Suppose the tool’s goal is a successful compressed-file export; track that success event.

dontConfuse.zh: 打开页面不是自动完成转化；GA4 关键事件也不自动等于收入。
dontConfuse.en: A page visit is not automatically a conversion; a GA4 key event is not automatically revenue.

evidence.zh: 先测试事件是否正确触发，再查实际使用、线索或订单。
evidence.en: Validate event firing, then inspect real usage, leads, or orders.

plain.zh: 放在网站根目录、告诉守规矩爬虫哪些路径可以抓取的文件。
plain.en: A root-level file giving compliant crawlers rules about which paths they may crawl.

example.zh: 假设禁止抓取 /drafts/，爬虫可能仍从外链知道那些网址。
example.en: If crawling /drafts/ is disallowed, external links can still reveal those URLs.

dontConfuse.zh: robots.txt 不是可靠的去索引或隐私保护手段。
dontConfuse.en: robots.txt is not a reliable deindexing or privacy mechanism.

evidence.zh: 查看真实 /robots.txt 与 URL 检查的抓取允许状态。
evidence.en: Inspect the live /robots.txt and crawl-allowed status in URL Inspection.

plain.zh: 告诉支持它的搜索引擎不要把这个页面放进搜索结果。
plain.en: A directive asking supporting engines to exclude the page from search results.

example.zh: 假设公开测试页带 noindex；发布正式页前检查是否误保留。
example.en: Suppose a public test page has noindex; check it was removed from the intended live page.

dontConfuse.zh: Google 必须能抓取页面才能读取 noindex；它也不是登录保护。
dontConfuse.en: Google must crawl the page to read noindex; it is not access control.

evidence.zh: 检查 robots meta、X-Robots-Tag 与抓取权限。
evidence.en: Inspect robots meta, X-Robots-Tag, and crawl access.

plain.zh: 相似或重复内容里，你建议搜索引擎优先认定的代表网址。
plain.en: The representative URL you recommend for duplicate or very similar content.

example.zh: 假设 /compress?ref=news 与 /compress 内容相同，建议后者为 canonical。
example.en: If /compress?ref=news duplicates /compress, recommend the clean URL.

dontConfuse.zh: canonical 是信号，不是强制命令、跳转或删页。
dontConfuse.en: Canonical is a signal, not a command, redirect, or deletion.

evidence.zh: 核对声明的 canonical 与 Google 选择的 canonical。
evidence.en: Compare declared and Google-selected canonical URLs.

plain.zh: 列出你希望搜索引擎发现的重要网址的文件。
plain.en: A file listing important URLs you want search engines to discover.

example.zh: 假设新增工具页，把正式网址加入 sitemap 并检查读取情况。
example.en: Suppose you add a tool: include its preferred URL and check sitemap processing.

dontConfuse.zh: 提交成功不保证抓取或收录，也替代不了页面间导航。
dontConfuse.en: Successful submission guarantees neither crawling nor indexing and does not replace navigation.

evidence.zh: 站点地图是否可访问、报告是否成功读取、网址是否正确。
evidence.en: Check accessibility, processing status, and correctness of listed URLs.

plain.zh: 你网站上的一个页面链接到同一网站的另一个页面。
plain.en: A link from one page of your site to another.

example.zh: 假设 PNG 教程用“批量压缩 PNG”链接到对应工具页。
example.en: A PNG guide links to its tool using “batch compress PNGs”.

dontConfuse.zh: 内链不是只把页面塞进 sitemap；关键链接要真的能点击和被识别。
dontConfuse.en: A sitemap entry is not an internal link; important links should be usable and crawlable.

evidence.zh: 检查 a 元素的 href、目标响应和锚文本是否清楚。
evidence.en: Check anchor hrefs, destination responses, and descriptive link text.

plain.zh: 其他网站指向你页面的链接；你引用外站则是出站链接。
plain.en: A link from another website to yours; your link to another site is outbound.

example.zh: 假设设计教程作者自然引用你的压缩工具。
example.en: Suppose a design tutorial independently references your compression tool.

dontConfuse.zh: 外链数量不等于质量；为操纵排名买卖链接有风险。
dontConfuse.en: Link count is not quality; buying or selling links to manipulate rankings is risky.

evidence.zh: 查看真实来源页、上下文、相关性及带来的访问。
evidence.en: Inspect the source page, context, relevance, and referral visits.

term.zh: 语言 / 地区版本标注

plain.zh: 告诉 Google 哪些网址是同一内容的不同语言或地区版本。
plain.en: An annotation identifying equivalent language or regional versions for Google.

example.zh: 假设 /zh/compress 与 /en/compress 相互标注 zh 与 en，并各自标注自己。
example.en: Suppose /zh/compress and /en/compress list both themselves and each other as zh/en alternatives.

dontConfuse.zh: 它不会翻译页面，也不应把无关页面强行配成语言版本。
dontConfuse.en: It does not translate pages or make unrelated pages equivalents.

evidence.zh: 检查双向与自引用、完整网址、语言代码及真实内容对应。
evidence.en: Check reciprocal/self references, full URLs, language codes, and equivalent content.

plain.zh: 页面 title 描述主题；搜索结果标题可能由 Google 综合生成。
plain.en: Your title describes the page; Google may generate the result’s title from multiple sources.

example.zh: 假设标题是“透明 PNG 批量压缩工具”，正文确实支持这个功能。
example.en: Suppose the title promises a transparent-PNG batch compressor, and the page supports it.

dontConfuse.zh: HTML title、正文 H1 与搜索结果标题不是同一个字段。
dontConfuse.en: HTML title, visible H1, and search-result title are distinct.

evidence.zh: 核对 title、可见主标题、实际结果与页面能力。
evidence.en: Compare title, visible heading, actual results, and page capabilities.

plain.zh: 你可写页面描述；Google 的结果摘要也可能取自正文。
plain.en: You can provide a description; Google may instead build the snippet from page content.

example.zh: 假设写明“保留透明背景，支持批量处理”，并确保页面能兑现。
example.en: Suppose the description says “preserves transparency and supports batches”; verify both.

dontConfuse.zh: 写了描述不代表 Google 必须原样展示。
dontConfuse.en: Providing a description does not guarantee it appears verbatim.

evidence.zh: 比较 meta description、正文和不同查询下的实际摘要。
evidence.en: Compare the description, page text, and snippets for different queries.

sourcesNote.zh: 搜索意图、关键词分组和长尾词为本教程的工作定义；所链 Google 指南提供相关背景，不宣称这些分类是 Google 的官方指标。
sourcesNote.en: Search intent, keyword grouping, and long-tail are working definitions for this guide. Linked Google guidance supplies background, not an official Google taxonomy or metric.
